instruction: A huggable narwhal sewn from soft periwinkle fleece with a topstitched seam running along its spine and a pale cream underbelly panel. Its spiral tusk is a twisted corduroy cone in ivory, and its eyes are two shiny black shank buttons above blush-pink felt cheek circles. The tail flukes are flat quilted fabric with visible stitching around the edges.
